_comment: Spec §2.3 — frozen testbed configuration. Do not change mid-campaign.

core.software: Open5GS v2.7.6 (UNCHANGED from the UERANSIM testbed)

ran.gnb_note: GitHub repo archived Dec 2025; project moved to OCUDU. Pinned to the last GitHub release.
ran.bandwidth_rationale: 20 MHz matches srsRAN's shipped srsUE reference config (valid CORESET#0 idx 12; 10 MHz was rejected by the gNB). ZMQ loopback sustains ~2.2 GB/s vs the ~184 MB/s required, so the MAC scheduler and not the transport sets C.
ran.inactivity_rationale: srsRAN app default is 120 s, which released the UE to RRC_IDLE between probe ticks and zeroed the data plane.

ue_isolation.mechanism: one Linux network namespace per UE (ue1..ueN)
ue_isolation.why: Under UERANSIM every UE address sat in the HOST local routing table, so downlink was short-circuited to lo. rx was 0 on every tunnel in every run ever recorded (0 non-zero total_rx_bytes across 3846 result files). Namespaces remove that short-circuit.

host_prep_required: iptables -t nat MASQUERADE for 10.45.0.0/16 (documented in network_run.md, never created by any script)
explicit iptables ACCEPT for 10.45.0.0/16 in INPUT/FORWARD/OUTPUT — host runs k3s with -P INPUT DROP and -P FORWARD DROP plus ufw (147 KUBE-* rules); ICMP passed but every TCP SYN was dropped
default route inside each UE netns (srsUE creates only the on-link /24)

first_measurements.note: First genuinely measured throughput in this project. Under UERANSIM tau was max(1.0, 15.0*20/AMBR)*0.9 — arithmetic, reproduced exactly on 382/382 stored values.

status: Phase 0 COMPLETE — all four gates passed. Next: E1 asymmetric harm.

E0.1_ambr_enforcement.native: FAILED — 54.2 Mbps flat across a 40x AMBR sweep; Open5GS applies no QER policing
E0.1_ambr_enforcement.htb_standin: PASSED — tracks configured AMBR at a constant 0.963 ratio (protocol overhead)

E0.2_scale.result: PASSED, n=4 concurrent UEs, distinct IPs, stable 60s, gnb_late_markers=0
E0.2_scale.mechanism: GNU Radio flowgraph broker (srsRAN official); gNB ZMQ is REQ/REP 1:1 only
E0.2_scale.enabler: PRACH pool per srsRAN maintainers: total_nof_ra_preambles 64, nof_ssb_per_ro 1, nof_cb_preambles_per_ssb 64

E0.4_two_regime.below_knee: tau tracks AMBR at 0.96; latency low
E0.4_two_regime.above_knee: tau saturates at C/n = 5.84; latency rises 54.5 -> 410 ms (7.5x)

measurement_bugs_found_and_fixed: lambda was sampled AFTER the load finished (link idle) — made latency look flat at ~73ms across the whole sweep. Now sampled concurrently with iperf3.
rho omitted -R so it measured the UNSHAPED UPLINK — reported 0.0% every time, reproducing the constant-rho degeneracy this rebuild exists to remove. Now downlink.
rho ran one UE at a time — no contention during the loss test. Now concurrent.
one iperf3 server cannot serve n concurrent clients; each UE now has its own port.

remaining_caveats.rho: still ~0 except the final sweep point (0.188). Near-degenerate; report per-dimension, do not hide inside a scalar Q.
remaining_caveats.sigma: constant at 4 by construction (n is fixed). Carries no information — drop from Q or report separately.
remaining_caveats.enforcement_point: per-UE HTB on ogstun, DECLARED stand-in for the TS 29.244 QER (E0.1 showed Open5GS does not police Session-AMBR).
remaining_caveats.broker: GNU Radio sits in the sample path; srsRAN's own docs call this 'not an optimized, performant, or scalable solution'. Must be declared.
